title: ICAO Annex 9 §8.15 — Failure to Provide Required Assistance, Documentation, and Transparent Complaint Resolution
category: ICAO Standards Violation / Treaty Breach — Complaint Resolution Failures
allegation_summary: Following the improper removal of passenger [[SPK-passenger-leandro]] from flight LA8159, both LATAM Airlines Brazil (TAM Linhas Aéreas) and DGAC Chile systematically failed to provide assistance, documentation, or access to a transparent complaint resolution mechanism as required by ICAO Annex 9 Standard 8.15. The passenger was denied written documentation of the removal grounds, denied access to complaint procedures, and subsequently subjected to a lifetime ban without any review mechanism. LATAM staff implemented a documented 'no signatures' policy designed to evade accountability.

articles.article_name: Chicago Convention, Art. 37 — Adoption of International Standards and Procedures
articles.article_text: Each contracting State undertakes to collaborate in securing the highest practicable degree of uniformity in regulations, standards, procedures, and organization in relation to aircraft, personnel, airways and auxiliary services in all matters in which such uniformity will facilitate and improve air navigation.
articles.applicability_rationale: legacy paraphrase: Each contracting State undertakes to collaborate in securing the highest practicable degree of uniformity in regulations, standards, procedures, and organization.

articles.article_name: Chicago Convention, Art. 38 — Departures from International Standards and Procedures
articles.article_text: Any State which finds it impracticable to comply in all respects with any such international standard or procedure, or to bring its own regulations or practices into full accord with any international standard or procedure after amendment of the latter, or which deems it necessary to adopt regulations or practices differing in any particular respect from those established by an international standard, shall give immediate notification to the International Civil Aviation Organization of the differences between its own practice and that established by the international standard.
articles.applicability_rationale: Article text corrected to canonical Chicago Convention Art. 38 wording. Previous version added editorial gloss ('failure to implement §8.15 without notification constitutes a treaty breach') not present in the treaty text. | legacy paraphrase: Any State which finds it impracticable to comply in all respects with any such international standard or procedure shall give immediate notification to ICAO of the differences between its own practice and that established by the international standard.

articles.article_text: Every treaty in force is binding upon the parties to it and must be performed by them in good faith (pacta sunt servanda).

candidate_articles.preliminary_view: Standard 8.15: Contracting States shall ensure that aircraft operators establish transparent and effective complaint resolution mechanisms for passengers, providing timely written responses and maintaining proper documentation of all compla
candidate_articles.history_note: Merged from two entries (S15 + synthetic S15.DOC). Standard 8.15 is a single unified SARP. The state duty (ensure mechanisms exist) and operator duty (maintain documentation) are both part of the same Standard. The 'S15.DOC' subdivision was an editorial creation not present in ICAO Annex 9.
